title: A/R Collection: every location is listed, whatever your enrollment
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, an "Admin" user enrolled only at {Location-A}, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-10 One Place; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in this report at {Location-A} and {Location-B} on today's date.
    For example: {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the rows' Location column.
  2. Click the Location chip and read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows from {Location-B} are shown too: the report stays organization-wide.
  • Step 2: both {Location-A} and {Location-B} are listed and ticked, although you are enrolled only at {Location-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R3: “The list offers every location at which the organization has open documents in this report on the as-of date, whatever location the user is signed into and whatever locations they are enrolled in. It is not narrowed by the Location filter, the customer or vendor filter, or the Past due filter; it changes only with the as-of date.”
  • S5-R12: “The filter does not change who can see what: everyone who can open these reports sees every location's data, as today.”
  • Out of Scope: “Restricting these reports by the user's location enrollment. The reports stay organization-wide for everyone who can open them today; the Location filter only narrows. Any enrollment-based restriction would be its own announced permissions change.”
  • Key Decisions, organization-wide: “The reports stay organization-wide, by decision. Everyone with access sees every location's data, as today; the Location filter only narrows. Rationale: no permission changes in this release (decided 2026-10-15). Rejected: restricting the reports to the locations a user is enrolled in, which would be its own announced permissions change later.”
  • Goals: “Nobody gains or loses access to any data, and no setup is needed.”
